comment: She's a solid prof. She's really responsive if you have problems and is willing to help. If you stay on top of your work you'll be fine.

I really like this professor. Her lectures are interesting and the material is sound. Her tests can be difficult, but they are taken from the class lectures. She tells a lot of stories, but they are terrific and reflect what she is teaching. I loved it! Also, great videos. Take her if you can!

Dr. Schenkel is an okay professor, scatterbrained at times but usually because she wants to talk about something interesting. She posts the lecture slides so attendance is semi optional, but she usually asks questions on the tests that she doesn't go over in the slides. It's a psych class. Show up, have a pulse, and you'll do fine.

Dr. Schenkel is one of my favorite professors and she effortlessly makes her classes enjoyable with her tangents and experiences. Her classes are powerpoint-based and if you study those, you're set for exams. Easy A with interesting topics as well.

Makes class fun and a bit laid back. She loves to cut into side tangents, which cuts both ways in how it impacts the lecture. She acts a bit ditsy at times, but is really invested in this materials, and that is projected outwards to the class. Here wasn't any homework, but the lecture notes were great to study from for tests.

So I took this class based on the reviews here... and I regret it.  I thought this would be a cakewalk. The extra credit is SONA stuff, the tests are hard, unless you make it a priority to study for 3 days to get above an 80.  And my friend and I wrote our papers together (they were very different) and I got an 86 and she got a 96.. thats fair

Great professor for ab. psych. 4 exams with one drop including cumulative final if you choose not to take it. One paper but it's easy and opinion based. Lectures are fun and there are TONS of great videos. extra credit adds 4 points to your average! Take a course with her if you can!!!

Had her for psychological testing. Interesting class. Some fun assignments but a good amount of work .. A lot due at the end. She is really good.. Knows what she is talking about. I would take her again.
Abnormal Psy -- great class with Dr. Schenkel.  She makes all of the lectures very interesting and combines them with movies.  Excellent Professor!!!
Great teacher, certainly not timely with grading though. All you gotta do is show up and know the lectures and videos.
Good class. Tests can be hard. Study the lectures and class notes.

very interesting information, very nice professor. she uses videos a lot which keep it interesting, but goes through power points really fast. tests get harder as the quarter goes, but if you know the book, you will get an A. also, lots of extra credit opportunity.

She's pretty knowledgeable and gives you good, solid information. She doesnt take the time to even learn your names and doesn't care if you show up to class. Tests are straight from the powerpoints and videos.
I love this class. A lot of good information. One of my favorite professors at RIT!
Good Prof. Tests are clear and straight from lecture. Study from the slides and you will do well.

Had her for abnormaol. Great Class. Lectures were interesting. A lot of good information and good videos. She kept it very interesting and went off topic to talk about cases. Four exams, she takes the top 3. Study from the powerpoints. I would take her again, plus she is pretty cute!

This ended up being one of my favorite classes for the quarter. You're only graded on 3 exams and an essay so you have to be careful and do lots of extra credit. My only complaint was that we wasted 10-20 minutes a day while she figured out how to get a DVD to work. Lectures were interesting and full of videos and examples.
She is very discriminatory against foreign students.  Boring lectures...all she does is read from PPT..isn't helpful at all...

Dr. Schenkel is absolutely awsome!! She is the BEST!! Her presentations are succint to the relevent material and yet she can make the material come ALIVE. Psych is not my major, but because of her teaching, level of caring for the student, and exteme helpfulness, I would LOVE to take another class of hers. I would HIGHLY reccommend her to all!!!!!

Dr. Schenkel has been the absolute BEST!! She is extremely helpful and insightful, and I have learned so much from her in just the 1 class. Her presentations are succint,material is up to date and relevant to what is tested, plus she makes it very interesting and really holds the attention of the class. I would not hesitate to reccommend her at all

Not the best professor. She plays a dumb blonde a lot of the time.  Her voice and facial expressions were really annoying.  The textbook was so boring I never opened it.  Her lectures didn't help for the tests.  I wouldn't recommend her.

She has had the same powerpoints for the past few years.  She just reads them to you while you fill in the blanks in your handouts.  She gave out 4 point of extra credit on your average and the final is optional.  3 Tests, 1 final - she will take the best 3 grades.

She is one of my favorite professors that I've had thus far.  The tests are from the textbook and the powerpoints, which are posted online.  The book is very technical and boring, but she makes it interesting when she presents it to the class.

One of the best teachers I have had at RIT, and psychology isn't even my major!  Extremely kind and easy to get along with.  Tests are multiple choice, and come straight from powerpoint lectures.  Lots of information, but she makes it interesting.  I would love to take another one of her classes.
Awesome prof.Good lectures, take her class.

This was the first asynchronous class I ever took, so it was a bit confusing at first. I know it was also a big adjustment to switch it to online as much of the class is discussion-based. However, with time, it got more routine and Dr. Condry was very accessible. I really enjoyed having her as a professor!
Developmental Psych was awesome! Light workload but I still feel like I learned a lot. Only one quiz a week and two tests the whole time. Participation matters. 10/10 highly recommend

Prof. Condry is a great professor. Her lectures are clear, interesting and fun. She is very approachable and communicates well. I had never taken a Psych class before, and her passion for the subject showed me how truly interesting psychology is.

I'm currently getting close to finishing Research Methods 1 with Dr. Condry, and I wish she was teaching RM2 next semester. She's very attentive to and understanding of the needs and issues of her students, and has a lot of great insight for presenting the course materials in a thought-provoking and accessible way.

BEST PROFESSOR EVER. Class is very interesting and enjoyable, and she makes it easy! Only tests are a midterm and final. There is also a 4-6 pg paper. If you go to class, you can't get below an 85 on a test - (I got an easy 100 on the midterm).  I would love to take another class with her. TAKE HER, you won't regret it!

Condry is 1 in a million as far as a professor goes. I cannot offer her enough praise for being caring, understanding, approachable, respectable and flexible. Her classes are difficult but she makes them well worth attending and being a part of. She is the only reason I had hope ( as a disabled person) that Psychology was the right career path.
She is an easy going teacher. Read your materials and invest your effort in class. She assigns a lot of work but they're not really that hard.
Take her classes! She's a great professor. You won't regret it.

I had Professor Condry for Scientific Writing.  Be prepared for a lot of writing.  It is not hard nor is she a tough grader but it can feel extremely overwhelming.  She is very helpful and a likable person.  Just make sure you memorize APA references correctly since she kept on quizzing our class on this until we got it right.

Interesting class, overall not that bad but ALOT of work! She makes papers due way too often and when papers aren't due you still have a lot of work. Not the worse psychology class but definitely a lot more work then I expected , this class is the most work load of all my class. However maybe it's just because it's a writing class?

I absolutely love Prof Condry!!  She really cares that you understand her topics.  I have had her for 3 different classes now and each one has been absolutely amazing.  If you have the opportunity, take her class.
Really awesome and caring teacher.  Class is Really easy.  If you didn't do well on the tests it probably means you are brain dead and never came to class.  She is awesome

I had Condry for intro Psych. She is an awesome professor,very helpful, and cares about your success in her class. She was always straight foward about was was on the test and even gave study sheets. I hope thoses of you that are taking this class get lucky enough to have her!
Professor Condry is the best Psych. professor!  Her class is REALLY easy.  getting below an 85 on the tests probably means you NEVER looked over notes or did not come to class.  HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

The content of the class was extremely interesting and Condry did her best to illustrate the core concepts. Tests could be a bit ambiguous, but in-class discussions and easy papers raised grades substantially. Great professor overall!

I felt thet this professor's content and organization was not up to par. Yes she smiles alot and tries to be helpful, but I don't feel comfortable with her knowledge base. Frequebntly she seems to mix up studies and the results. Exams didn't reflect the content that was discussed most of the time in class. NOT impressed at all. Cannot reccommend
Child Psych isn't really my thing, but she made the class pretty interesting. Shes also my advisor and will go out of her way to help you. She is one of the best professors in RITs psych program

One of the best professors in the RIT psych dept. Highly reccomended. Course content can be difficult,however this professor is willing to go the extra mile to help you. If you have any difficulties she is willing to help you. Lectures are excellent and engaging.Just purely amazing. I learned a whole lot. TAKE HER CLASSES!

Laura gives clear lectures, is generally really good about responding to questions quickly, and clearly wants to help you. The labs are challenging without feeling needlessly hard and are satisfying to complete. Instructions and grading criteria are very clear. I would definitely taker her again. Best online class I've ever had.

Good professor. The class was well organized and the labs were challenging and fun. I thought overall it was a good experience and despite giving us a fairly difficult final project, she understood that and graded accordingly. Definitely wanted the students to actually go learn instead of grind our gears for perfection.

I took a computer graphics class with her online. She is a good professor and makes sure to keep up to date notes. The only real problem I had with her is that halfway through the semester she stopped responding to emails/ it took awhile to get a reply. Other than that she's a good professor.
She is a terrible professor and very disorganized. If you're eager to learn take much more qualified professors who who are very knowledgeable about this field.

comment: The weekly quizzes on the readings for this class were really hard. Even if you read, they are only five questions and its hard to get all of them right. Other than that, I took this as a gen ed and the class was really enjoyable. You NEED to read the textbook assignments, but the readings aren't a lot of work
She doesn't take attendance and doesn't ask much, but if you don't do the work you better be ready not to pass.

The class wasn't very interesting to me but the teacher was great and engaging. She gives weekly quizzes online with 10 questions. The tests are multiple choice, a few short answer and one short essay question. She gives way too much reading for one week but I was able to pass the quizzes by skimming the readings and using the power points.

She's a great professor, and she absolutely loves what she teaches. She understands when you have a boatload of work and other issues that make life horrible. She's very clear about the content, and class is usually enjoyable if at least one person does some reading. The reading can be boring and dry sometimes, and there is a lot of it.

Very cool dude. I love him but sometimes he likes to scare you but I realized he's doing that to make you want to work harder. He's a great teacher. He will get mad if you miss his class, especially when you don't text him or email him letting him know first.

Manki Cho is one of my favorite professors ever. He cares about his students on a level different from the rest of not just the math department, but all of RIT. Project-Based Calculus 2 is not an easy class. You will need to work for it; do the optional homework and you'll succeed. It's not too much.

I loved being in Dr. Cho's class. He is very good at teaching Prob and Stats 1. He is kind and very helpful during office hours. The lectures are amazing. He makes us understand the topic instead of memorizing formulas. The quizzes are from the textbook examples and the exams from the homework. As a result, he made us practice a lot. Loved him!

Took Cho twice, first when it was his first time teaching at RIT, second was 2-3 years later. As usual he is funny, knows what he is talking about, and easy if you do homework. If you show you care you will do well. His personality is one of the best I seen for a non major class at RIT. His accent he has isn't an issue and clarifies if have a prblm

Dr. Cho is the best math professor I have ever taken. He is hilarious and makes lectures entertaining and concepts easy to understand. He comes off as strict but that does nothing but command your respect for his class. Definitely do the homework as it helps a lot for the quizzes and tests.

comment: Great professor. Hilarious and cares about students. Accent should not be a problem. Tough grader, but he makes sure you know his expectations. Quizzes, exams, and one 5% project are the only graded items. Final is 35%, which I thought was a lot, but it worked out. Gives a lot of detail about what problems will be on quizzes and exams.

He does a really good job teaching and is very willing to help you anytime. Has a tough accent to understand, but you get used to it. A lot of the quizzes were from the homework which he doesn't collect but definitely do them to practice. Tests were pretty straightforward.

comment: Cho made the class incredibly easy and make sense. He taught in a way where you derive the material yourself, but it wasn't a crucial part of the course. He is Korean so he has a bit of an accent sometimes, but for the most part he is easy to understand. Definitely suggest.
Great professor. Homework was optional, but still a great way to study for the .1% who did it. Accent takes some getting used to but not hard to understand.

Dr Cho is easily the best math teacher I have ever had. Great guy, has a slight accent but easy to get pass. Very open to explain things that you have questions about. Very knowledgeable. His style of teaching makes you understand the subject. 10/10 would take again, for any class.
If you don't get an A in this class it simply means you didn't do the work. It's impossible to fail.

A knowledgeable professor who can be both serious and light-hearted. Very willing to meet during office hours or by appointment and will try to explain. However, he has a thick Korean accent and it can be hard to understand him at times. The tests and quizzes can be very easy if you do the homework. Don't do the homework, and you'll struggle.

Manki Cho is one of the best professors I've ever had. He conveys the material very clearly and is very accessible outside of class and very willing to review course material as well as material from past courses. He is very forgiving and genuinely wants his students to pass, so long as they prove they know the material. I would 100% take him again

MATH171 with Prof. Cho was way harder than it should have been. I felt as if this class was too low of a level for him to teach and he didn't understand that the class was just trying to learn the basics of calculus. Smart guy, just not the best at teaching. Tests were impossible, Ive never seen kids get straight 0's on a math test until this class

Calc 2 is a hard topic, but Prof Cho did a great job teaching it. He clearly explains concepts, and if you need extra help is great one-on-one at office hours and willing to meet outside them if you need also. Study from his practice tests!! The real test is similar (sometimes SAME ques. used!!) Also very amusing during lecture, kept it interesting

comment: Professor Cho has quickly become one of my favorite professors. He's smart, witty, and teaches the material clearly and concisely.

This guy is the best. I have taken this class more times than I care to admit, so take it from me when I say he's the best there is. Returns grades faster than anyone on campus. Easy project portion. comment: Professor Cho does an excellent job going over the material and has a great sense of humor. Reading the textbook is not necessary, though you might find it helpful if you are having trouble understanding any of the concepts covered in class (alternatively, you could meet with him during office hours).

Professor Cho does everything he can to make sure his students succeed. He's very approachable if you ever need any help, and he has a great sense of humor which keeps his lectures interesting. I'd recommend him to anyone and plan to continue taking his courses myself as the years progress.

Dont just look at the rating, read He does have an accent, but that doesn't affect his teaching at all.  His homeworks are "optional", but I recommend you do them.  They don't take too much time and his quizzes are entirely based on the hw 90% of the time. He is not an easy A. His exams after the first were pretty challenging, but nothing crazy.
One time he he gave out a quiz and everyone got like a 40 and he didn't drop the quiz grade. His tests are also waaay harder than they should be. He has a decent sense of humor though.
You need 12 pages of writing for the whole quarter so it's not too much, but the material forces writing about a certain topic. There is little flexibility for the topics of the papers.
extremely knowledgeable of course material, has a strong idea of what direction students should take, follow guidelines and you'll get a good grade

This is an intelligent professor. Dr. Connor challenges your thinking and has you learn beyond your expectations. Good grades aren't difficult as long as you participate in the process. Be open and take his classes. I have twice, and would again if he had more available.

Very sarcastic. Do your work and he'll like you, you really dont need to be a great writer to get an A, just follow the way he wants the paper done and your solid. Hes not very helpful but the class is simple, you write three long papers. Thats it.

Kinda wings it in class, but easy A as long as you just do what he says. Its real simple, not a lot of work, hardly any readings, movies in class :D You write maybe one paper a quarter? Easy A, he even cancels classes on occasion! Reccomend.
He was horrible. He made us do a ton of work and I don't think I got anyhting out of it. The only nice thing is he is lenient on grades.

Margaret is nice. However, she has been the most frustrating professor I've ever had. She doesn't give full feedback until after you've turned everything and gotten your grade. She assigned projects every 2 weeks and you only get a week to complete revisions. She's also rly boring, the projects too. And she isn't always clear on what she wants.

comment: Pence is a tough grader, but I do learn a lot from her class. The only problem is that she assigns a new project every two weeks, meaning theres a project due every two weeks. Her grading is pretty intense but it does make you better.

Few times I emailed her with questions and she did replied me back right away. I am pleased with that. Also she helped me many times when I was stuck working on Illustrator during class. Margaret is nice, laid-back, fair and likable professor.
Took Vector Imaging with her (basic Illustrator class.) Grades pretty fairly. Moves pretty quickly. Knowledge of the subject not the best, as shown through personal examples.

She may seem dry and little boring at first, but once you warm up to her she's extremely helpful. She s patient and corrects you till you get it right. You'd have to work hard in her class and her work is amazing so she knows what she's talking about. Great class for a foundation and if you're trying to sharpen your artistic skills.
doesnt grade on effort, grades on ability, even than plays favorites.
Cared a lot about the students. The only class I enjoyed out of my foundation courses. If you try hard you will get an A. Also lets you do re-dos to improve your grade. Great Prof.!

By far the best professor I've had I learned more than in any other class. She was crystal clear on what she wanted and if you did that you get an A. Her work is exceptional and is willing to help everyone succeed.

*Grading is very subjective which could mean the 7-8 hours you put into your project will only produce a c. *Told the entire class that the art quality was "terrible" wasn't really the best approach to getting a point across. *Is a part time professor and has experience in the art world *Lecture can be very boring unless your really into art.
Magz is exceptional. I love her class and her positive attitude. She is not too easy and not too difficult... I love her! <3

She was very nit-picky and gave lower grades to everyone then they deserved.  I never saw her smile, she was very boring and dry, and she created an intense working atmosphere. I would not recommend her.

I have to disagree with the last comment -- Pence is certainly not EASY, but she will certainly make you a better artist. If you did the work, the class was an easy A.  She was my fav teacher of all the teachers I've had in foundations.

This professor provided the worst academic experience of my entire education. This course had no calendar, no syllabus, and no grading rubric. Prof Witz is one of the most frustrating professors to deal with. All of the one star ratings are 100% accurate. I saw his terrible reviews and still decided to enroll in his class to fulfill my lab requirement. If you are in the same predicament, save yourself the drop and don't enroll with him.

I dropped this class after 4 days. This online course is such a trainwreck that it's hard to actually pick apart and put into words, specifically, how baffling, frustrating, and nightmarish it is as a whole. It's a mess of broken third-party websites, unclear grading, and long, difficult assignment spam. Please save yourself the headache. Avoid.

Tough luck he wont give you flexibility. All of your grade depends on the Pearson mastering program. I had no $ for two weeks and he didnt even give me a chance after I finally got the books.

comment: Worst professor at RIT by far. I honestly don't know why he chose to be a teacher. If you have to take a course in his area of study, pick a different professor. If you have to wait for the next semester - do it, don't torture yourself. It's impossible to describe how awful he is in the amount of words we're allowed. Just don't take him.

comment: Don't take this class! It's a lot of time and effort on an online class that is rendered completely uninteresting and he is the worst grader. He takes off points for any grammatical error and yet he makes tons. The final term paper will ruin your grade, and he never responds to emails or specify what he wants for assignments.

Witz is very rude and will fight you on anything you have to say. He's unclear with what he wants and grades ridiculously for grammar.  Avoid him if you can; it's not worth worrying about 3x a week. The term paper was 7 pages long but he won't tell you what he wants for it, other than the .doc format and your citations (which were also weird).

Witz is one of the only professors I have ever clashed with. He is an EXTREMELY picky grader, despite the ambiguous assignment instructions. He's also extremely rude and condescending in his emailsfeedback. The online class makes you work and the quizzes were all trick questions. I'm a 3rd year double major and THIS is the class i'm worried about.

Terrible teacher and completely inconsiderate. Doesn't grade on merit, just grammar and gives no help or insight throughout the entire course. Acts incredibly rude and responds to any questions or emails as if they are a bother to him. Avoid at all costs.

Wouldn't suggest taking his class. Absolutely terrible at responding to emails. Isn't clear with project requirements (which so happens to be half of the grade). Rarely participated in class discussions. Never experienced such a terrible professor.
Teaches adjunct at RIT and full-time at Nazareth. Tough professor. Didn't answer students' questions. His grading is subjective. Avoid him if you can.

One of the best professors at RIT. She is very understanding and grades by competition. The class is very writing heavy but as long as you turn something in that has effort you get full points. Had to switch to asynchronous at the end of last semester due to health issues. If you can, Take her.

If you have the chance definitely take her. Her lectures are very engaging and she isn't afraid to delve into taboo topics. She is incredibly caring and understanding especially with some things I was going through this semester. The assignments are very writing heavy but as long as you do the work and try your best you will get an A.

A wonderful teacher, very caring and lovable. She does assign a decent amount of work but its relatively easy and mostly opinion based. She has a textbook she uses but you can access online. Would definitely recommend her.

One of the sweetest professors I've ever met. She gave clear instructions for what assignments there were for the week. Work was very easy, quite a bit of writing. No final, just a submission of paragraphs that she had assigned throughout the semester. So sad we had to go asynchronous at the end due to a health complication  :(
Jennifer was one of the best professors I've taken here. Has tons of stories from her time in the field, and was very flexible with work and assignments.

I think that Professor Wolfley is an angel in disguise. In between working as an outreach worker and chaplain, she spends her free time teaching. The care and respect given to the groups with which she works is incredibly apparent in her lectures. Her personal experience colors her lessons greatly. I couldn't recommend her more.
Political Science Professor Sarah Burns is the daughter of the CIA Director. You should bring her flowers and candy everyday and be very nice to her.

This is my second class with her and I'd love to take more. Assignments are clear and easy to follow, material is explicit but well-presented. She's always available outside of class time for anyone who needs her. Incredibly forgiving and knowledgeable. Textbook is required but she spends more class time talking about real-world examples. Love her!

Love her. One of the most caring and understanding professors I have ever had. Do the work and you'll get an A. That said... do not take her online. The online classes are so incredibly disorganized. I can't begin to describe how disorganized it was. It's manageable but it will drive you insane.
excellent material.

Took an online class with her. Originally was confused at the structure of her classroom setup but you get the hang of it. Super easy class and will get an A for sure as long as you do the work. Lots of videos each week, but all very interesting. Contact her through call is the fastest. Impossible to not get an A as long as you do the work

Tons of videos each week, watch and discuss each. Videos are captioned. Two lit reviews a semester. One research paper. She assigns us to research a person each week, research and discuss. A project more like a plan regarding PTSD. No office on campus, contact via phone not so much email. Assigns a question a week, counts as a final. Out of spaces.

Prof Jen is really cool and very knowledgeable about her field and is happy to chat, but she is extremely unorganized. As long as you post in the discussions every week you will be fine. You don't really need the textbook to answer discussion Q's about it. She will give you 100's on papers as long as you put some effort into them. Super easy A.

Great professor who knows what shes talking about and applies real world experience. Topics are very explicit but she keeps it interesting and informative. Online class is insanely disorganized. Hard to decipherfind assignments. As long as you participate in weekly discussions the class is very easy.

Easiest A I got in my life and I barely did any work. She's a great person and the topic is interesting but online classes are unorganizedall over the place. Too many surprise assignments and overall work.

Very unorganized. Information is very interesting but the assignments are lengthy and sometimes hard to find. However, she is pretty understanding if you are late on an assignment or two. Also an easy A if you participate and reply to her postings on a regular.

Jennifer Wolfley is extremely disorganized in her online class. No assignment outline and very hard to follow. As a straight- A student, I struggled to find where she posted assignments. She is also very hard to get in touch with and hardly anything makes sense. I will not be taking another online class with her.
Awesome teacher! One of the best! Definitely an easy A if you do all the homework she assigns and turn things in on time. Easy A! Cannot stress it enough!

Great Professor for some difficult to talk about topics. She really cares about the work she does and the people she helps. She approaches things in a soft fashion. She's also incredibly understanding when you have problems handling some of the material. Great lady, discussions are interesting, and the course is a good life builder.

Pretty awesome professor - course material is easy to understand and fairly interesting to follow. She's also fairly laid back so as long as you get your assignments in within the time frame, you're not going to have a problem. Finding the assignmnts kind of sucks since she posts assignments among student discussion posts.

great professor. if you do the work you'll do great. very helpful in fixing my grade for the class since the system screwed up. since it was an online class I never met her in person but when I called her for help I learned that I love her personality :) ill be taking 1 or 2 classes with her again

Professor Jen is awesome!! One of the Best professors I have had. She brings in her own experiences into the class and shares so much information. Never a dull moment. She is awesome.I took this class online but it did not seem like a normal online class, it was so interesting and I loved every minute. She is very understanding and caring.TAKE HER!

Professor Jenn is an excellent professor!  She brings personal experience into the classroom and makes learning more about the process and experiences then a grade on a paper.  She provides a true learning experience.  Very highly recommend!
Professor Jen is the greatest! Excellent teacher with tons of experience. She is very helpful and cares a lot about each one of her students. I highly recommend taking a course with her.

I took Prof. Jen for Writing Seminar online. I was initially hesitant on taking this class because of the topic, although through the progression of the course I enjoyed it and I would definitely recommend people to take her as well if they could. This was her first time teaching an online class but it was still very fun and not too hard either.

She is AWESOME!! Very easy courses ever! I learned so much from her, she loves to share her experiences, very open mind, and very flexible! She always share interesting topics! I suggest you to take this courses with her!

Professor Jenn is an Amazing professor and Amazing person. She shares her knowledge in a clear, selfless way. We learn from others experiences and knowledge. Seminar on Sexual Violence is very heavy material and somehow she is able to convey the seriousness of it along with lightening it up to make it so enjoyable to be in her class.She is the BEST

She is very amazing teacher I ever had. She is one of rare teachers who motivated me to do a lot of research and ask a lot of questions to be able to learn. She is very lovable lady and she loves to help. However, she has a high expectation of you to learn outside of the classroom! :)

This is a late rating as I took her class Spring Quarter of 2012, but one word to describe her. AMAZING. Total and complete clarity, not to mention hilarious. She's one of those professors that makes you look forward to attending the class. By far my favorite teacher in RIT. You can tell she genuinely cares about each of us.

Best teacher I've had at RIT. Jenn is hilarious, always keeping class interesting. I've had two classes with her and got an A in both. Subjects are interesting and I learned a good deal. Highly recommend!
If you like to hear off topic discussions about topics unrelated to CJ take her. I went into the class wanting to learn a lot, ended up not learning a thing that I did not already know.

Had her for Domestic Violence, she was a great teacher in a class where the subject matter can be difficult to hear. She does a great job at making everyone feel comfortable and learn. Would highly recommend taking any classes with her.

Undoubtedly the best professor I have had at RIT! I've taken 2 classes with her, and I'm taking a 3rd one in the Fall. She really doesn't ask too much of you - just read the material and participate and you'll do just fine. Discussions are interesting. Definitely recommend! You need to take at least one class with her while at RIT!

Jennifer is an awesome professor. She genuinely cares about her students & tries to make class as fun as possible although we have to discuss dark subjects at times. She does want everybody to participate in discussions & your grade will reflect how much you have participated! Definitely worth taking! :)

Jen is hilarious. Her classes are interesting to say the least. However, if you are looking for a blow-off class, Prostitution and Vice is not it. Class discussion is a big part of the grade but there is still quite a bit of writing involved. Textbook is also required, although you may find one of them at the library.

She was an awesome professor who always tried to keep class positive despite the dark subject. She was always helpful and the assignments were easy if you did the work and went to class. It was important to get involved in discussion and push the discussion along. Great class and professor I highly recommend any of her classes.

She will call your name for participate if you don't say any words in class. Being participate in class will give you a good grades because she loves to hear your opinions. She won't bite you. Do your papers and show up all classes, you'll receive an A in an easy way

I have take every class Jen Wolfley has taught at RIT. Best teacher out there by far! interesting, super easy to talk to, she actively engages the class, and honestly she cares about you and your ideas. shes the best honey-bunny professor out there~!!

Professor Jen is the sweetest, nicest, and most hilarious professor I've ever had the pleasure of taking a class with. Her essay assignments are a little vague, but she's an easy grader and ultimately values class discussion more. Lots of fun, take a class with her if you can!

This is the 2nd class I've take with Professor Jen & it was great! The material is different than any other criminal justice class I've taken & she gives interesting  & realistic perspective on the corrections system, focusing on inmates. The class is easy if you're engaged- don't skip out, she has a LOT of great things to say & stories to tell!
By far the best and most engaging teacher I have ever had. She is a professor that actually cares about the student and the substance of what we take from the classroom. She is simply DA BEST.
Professor Wolfley was an awesome teacher. Totally not what I expected from a Lit Prof. She is engaging, entertaining, and very passionate and knowledgeable. Highly recommend taking a class from her
Took Literature of Crime Arts of Expression Honors Class.  Absolutely AWESOME!! Take it if you get the chance, she's a great professor!

Jennifer Wolfley is AMAZING. After getting to know her on a personal and professional level, believe me -you will learn a lot in her class. The homework is fair and she gives us time to think about the subject matter. Wolfley makes sure everyone is comfortable in the classroom and listens to everyone. I STRONGLY recommend you to take this class.

I have taken quite a few classes with Professor Wolfley as a CJ major. Her classes are never, ever boring and she makes sure that each student takes something away from her class. She has the real-world experiences to back up just about every topic, and these stories never fail to entertain. If you get a chance to take her class, TAKE IT

Best teacher ever!! She is funny and easy going. To get a good grade do the work and show up to class. The papers she gives aren't long and the quality of learning is exceptional. If you don't get what she's talking about then just ask and she'll break it down for you.
Best teacher at RIT. Take a class with her and you won't regret it! She's hilarious and she finds a way to make tough situations easier to learn about.
One of my favorite teachers ever, lots of fun, not a lot of work, and class is always interesting, she loves to her what you have to say and isnt afraid to voice her opinion as well

One of the best professors at RIT, hands down. I took a class with her because a friend of mine recommended her, even though I had no interest in the class at first. It turned out to be one of the best classes I've taken. Homework is minimal, but make sure to actually do it. She's extremely funny and knows a lot about her field. Take her if you can

Best teacher I have ever had! Incredibly interesting class and she is so interesting!! Take her for everything/anything you can! I took her for my Arts of Expression class and one of my favorite classes I have ever taken, and I'm not even a Criminal Justice major. She's hilarious and knows what she's talking about. Also, homework is minimal/easy.

This woman is amazing! She had me laughing so hard I was in tears a couple times. Not only is she funny, she is very interesting and knowledgeable. I didn't think this class would benefit me at all, but I actually learned a lot. If you hand in your work you'll get an A. Do whatever it takes to get in a class with her.
The best professor I have EVER had

Take her!!! Shes absolutely hilarious, so nice, and very understanding.  If you participate in class discussions she'll automatically love you. We wrote two papers on something that interested us.  Our class topic for the quarter was love, sex, and intimacy.  What could be better? Take her!

I couldn't have asked for a better writing seminar teacher. It's worth waiting until sophomore year to take it with her. Seriously. You won't regret it. Prof. Jen is hilarious, the class discussions are interesting and you will laugh your ass off more than once. Take her. Seriously.

Prof Wolfley is amazing. The class topics are relatable and interesting. We wrote two papers on something that we were interested in, and watched 4 great films. Speak up in class and she'll love you. She's hilarious and really understanding of the work load we all have. Take HER!!!!!!!
Although I have never really enjoyed writing,this class was great. Professor Jen was very helpful and made the class interesting and enjoyable. I would highly recommend taking her class.

One word describes this professor: intriguing. Prof. Wolfley has gone through a lot in life and brings an amazing amount of insight and experience to the classroom. She cares about the subjects she teaches, her students, and their success. The best professors are those who KNOW their subject area and know it well, and she definitely does. :-)

Very fun and caring professor! Always willing to help out her students, and very knowledgeable about her field. Lectures are filled with lots of personal anecdotes that are sure to keep your interest! Great sense of human and very personable with students, as well!
Lots of fun. Takes an interest in her students. Never a dull moment. Even her class is offered at 8am, you will go just to be amused. I'm totally taking more of her classes just for kicks.

She is the best teacher! She is really interesting and brings her personal experience into her stories. She doesn't load with work, and doesn't require you buy textbooks. No finals. Ive taken two classes with her and will take more. Love her.

Pretty easy class. You only have to write a few short essay for the whole quarter. No final. Very little reading to do. Some of the lectures can be a bit boring, but others can be amazing. She is very sweet and tries to keep the class as interesting as possible.
A very nice and lenient teacher. If you don't want to worry about a lot of work, pick her.
Very good professor. I think everyone should take a class with her. She is very blunt and to the point and has a very good sense of humor about it. Very lenient and fun professor.

This is by far the best teacher i have ever had. She loves to teach. She focuses not on bombarding people with work, but rather making sure we can understand the content and take something away from the class and use in the real world. Long story short if you have a chance to be in any of her classes you'll be glad you did.

Best teacher ever. She is a very fair grader. There were only three three-page papers we had to write, one eight page research paper, and a few journal entries instead of a final. Tells hilarious stories from her own life and I always looked forward to her classes. We read a book and watched three movies that really covered the topic of the class.

Writing Seminar doesn't get much better than with Professor Jenn. Shes amazing. Essays are fair and require alot of thought, but she isnt a tough grader and lets you work for a grade booster. Her stories  from real life are amazing and tie into all the material.

I had "Professor Jenn" as she calls herself my first semester of freshman year. I saw writing seminar & was totally bummed out. I had no interest in taking it at all. However Professor Jenn told hilarious stories every class & always kept me interested. I had a great experience & the papers were easy. She's an amazing professor! Lots of fun.

This was a new course under Criminal Justice and it was fantastic.  She co-taught the course, but she had a deep interest in students and helping them to understand the subject. Very very easy course, take home midterm/final... but the course is mostly free form and open to all discussion.  Very informal and fun, she's a blast!
shes great, tells lots of cool stories, i've heard shes the easiest writing teacher.  There are papers but they are pretty easy, she cares about us which is awesome.
The best teacher RIT has to offer!
She's awesome! It's like seeing a comedian for every class. watch a bunch of movies and fairly easy going if you do your work and show up for class.

Easy enough A if you do what she tells you to. A lot of her stories are really funny and leave you wondering if she really just said that but others are just flat out disturbing you might learn stuff in this class, but not really how to write. If you cant do that by now then go home, otherwise you might want to take this class.
Best teacher ever! This class is hilarious, while still learning alot. Lots of amazing movies. Great class. If you have to take writing make sure you get wolfley
awesome class.  Shes really entertaining.  watch a lot of movies, and write about them.

She is the best teacher anyone can ever have! She is hilarious and you just cannot sleep in her class with all her funny experiences she tells us. If you just listen to her and do the assgined readings...its an A
she rocks ! if you wanna learn adn laugh adn have fun and actually look forward goign to a class take her ! <33333333333333
She is great. I loved going to her class.

I absolutly love Jennifer Wolfley. In all honesty if you do not get to take a class with her you should just drop out now, because there is no other reason to go to this school. Jen is THE best. she honestly cares about you, seriously I was thinking about transfering and she would talk to me everyday about going to check out colleges together.

i LOVED this class so much. jen made everyone interested, laugh, and learn at the same time. everything a perfect prof should do, she did everyday. i wish that i could take more classes with her in the future! definitly the best professor i have ever met/taken here at RIT. if you dont get her you're missing out.

She's got a story for every situation. Don't get me wrong, she's no comedian. SHE CAN TEACH her stuff. Classes end early, workload is challenging. Definitely one of the best teachers ever. Too bad they might be removing Writing & Lit from new curriculum...
Best professor ever!

omg she is by far the most fun professor that i've had at RIT! Hilarious and makes every class something to look forward to. Her grading is kinda challenging but it isnt hard to get an A if you put in the effort. I am definitely taking her in w&l 2. No final, loves letting us out early. Amazing!!!
she's awesome ...i dont mind going to her class

She is one of those teachers who tells you at the beginning that she is interested in what YOU think, not what SHE thinks, and then makes the opposite entirely obvious. She likes to hear herself talk and doesn't have much of use to say.

A good professor who is usually easy to reach out to outside of class. He's very clear with what he expects for each part of the term project and will usually return grades and feedback in a timely fashion. Lectures aren't that bad with all the class material available online.

Dr. Bavikadi is very knowledgeable about Machine Intelligence and can answer almost any question you have on the topic, even if it's outside of the scope of the class. She provided informative lectures and is understanding, just make sure to follow what is on the syllabus.

This professor promises a lot of things but usually goes back on her words. For an important presentation worth 25% if your final grade, her feedback was nothing. No clue if she even watched our presentation. One of the homeworks was changed a day before it was due without an email or anything saying it changed. Lectures were not engaging.

Bavikadi is a nice person. However, she doesn't stick to the syllabus and any feedback (if you get any) is very brief. No study material for moderately difficult exams. Homeworks are vague and homework questions are usually only answered during office hours. Lack of confidence in teaching leads to hard to understand and boring lectures.

While Dr. Patel possesses a command of textbook theory, his instruction is often mired in outdated and overly academic approaches. He would greatly benefit from moving beyond rote, theoretical recitation to incorporate contemporary, practical applications, as his current methods hinder clear understanding and student engagement.

Professor Sharma demonstrates strong theoretical knowledge but needs to balance technical depth with practical, modern examples to improve clarity and engagement regarding complex architecture concepts

comment: Boring lecture. Hard exams and no practice exams. Some homework are confusing and very unclear. Syllabus says lowest homework is dropped but is not actually dropped.

Homeworks take forever to do, lectures are really confusing and most the time no one in class have any idea on what's going on. Exam was so hard for no reason, no even close to the homework examples when she said “study the homework”. 5 mins left of the exam and the whole class was still there. Makes this class harder than it needs to be.

comment: Professor does not have any confidence in the material being taught, homeworks/exams do not make sense, and most of the class was review from previous courses over new content which should have been taught to a greater extent. The questions on homeworks/exams are consistently stated in a way that she either needs to change them, or restate them. :(

Hard to understand in lecture, and her questions are often unclear. Homework and exam grading focuses more on whether you interpreted what she meant rather than whether your answer is actually correct, so you can lose points even when your solution is right.

He hit his prime 20 years ago. He talks to himself a lot, and laughs at his own jokes. You'll frequently find him stop talking mid-sentence because he forgot what he was going to say. His directions are unclear in class, and he is "not afraid to fail the whole class". If the whole class is doing poorly, then it's obviously the teachers fault.
Overall nice guy but very difficult to understand. Questions on exams had material not covered in class; didn't go over material in exams after returned either.
DO NOT TAKE A CLASS WITH THIS PROFESSOR IF YOU HAVE ANY OTHER OPTION!
his version of teaching our class was to tell us how we were all bad students, sorry, "professionals in training" and needed to know the material without him to "hold [our] hands"

Not a good teacher if you need someone who is great at explianing himself. He doesn't do a good job of TEACHING even though that's what he there for. He knows his stuff but doesn't know how to convey his knowledge.

He is a good guy but not cut out to teach others.  He knows his stuff but can't teach to under his level unless you ask A LOT of questions.  If you go to his office hours and ask him questions about what you need help with he will eventually get to a point where you can understand.  It is hard to understand material from his lectures.

Great teacher. Had him for Electronics 1. (0609-360) Encourages students comments and questions and does a great job of answering questions. Only good teacher I have had throughout the Electronics series.
Can't frickin teach.
Unable to teach on a level below his, and terribly unclear. Very poor professor.
Had Prof. Hurney when he was an adjunct.  Great teacher that actually motivates!
ROB IS AMAZING! I wish I would have a class every semester with him. He is super knowledgeable, funny, and nice. You will learn so much from him.

really helpful and wanted students to become familiar with the machines. He has a lot of experience and can give you advice on almost any process. Course is new, so it was a little disorganized, but it's definitely a good idea to take it if you're in MechE
He is simply the best! Super cool and interesting to work with. Has a good sense of humor too. Overall, a nice, cool guy.
Very helpful when you are just getting to know the machines and is extremely knowledgeable about the subject. He is great during class, letting you do it and answering any questions you might have.
Awesome class. Explained machining processes well. Very fun class if you like machining. Take if you get the chance. Good for experience on resumes and co-ops.

Had him for intermediate machining.  He was really helpful and wanted students to become familiar with the machines.  He has a lot of experience and can give you advice on almost any process.  Course is new, so it was a little disorganized, but it's definitely a good idea to take it if you're in MechE.  I wish RIT offered another machining course.

I enjoyed this class, I wish he taught all of my engineering classes. Very kind, good sense of humor. Wonderful sense of humor, easy to get along with. Also he's willing to take you step by step through your project, and makes sure you know what you're doing. Most awesome dude ever.

Awesome class. Easy A. Kraynik is extremely helpful and wants the kids to do well. Grading is very easy and at the end of the class, you get to keep the hammer you make. I was completely new to the machines when I started taking the class, but after some demonstrations and questions, I never had problems. My hammer came out great.

This professor has tons of first hand experience with traveling and design, etc. She has a lot of knowledge about a lot of things, but her class was a bit unorganized, the first month of the course we had no idea what she was talking about or how it pertained to the class. Overall though, good prof, do your work and be prepared and you'll be fine.
Great speaker; really knows what she is talking about. Best class I've taken
great teacher
Most amazing professor I've ever had!!!! She cares so much about her students and she's a real life bad ass  with the kind of research projects she does. 10/10 would recommend!!

Dr. Hickerson is my favorite professor at RIT! Her class is amazing and she does everything in her power to help her students. You won't want to miss class because it's so interesting. Plus, she tells great stories about her real life experiences and is always willing to talk one-on-one

Took the online graduate level Crafting the Message course. Course has a lot of interesting reading assignments and shorter assignments. One large paper at the end. She used Adobe Connect to offer optional live lectures, which were very helpful and fun. Readings are all free and online!

Professor Chapman is very good professor. I took her for Acting in Film and she opened my eyes and definitely pushed me to the best of my ability. You can tell she genuinely cares about what she teaches to her students and will even go out of her way to help you if you don't understand a particular topic or are confused.

She taught the online portion. Very nice and is helpful, but because its online there is only so much. You have to police yourself if you're taking this section. It's a pretty easy class, an incredibly useless, but you sorta have to take it. Regardless of who you take its a boring class. Online courses involves a term paper and weekly discussions.
Tina is a really nice lady but has a very outdated knowledge of networking. Shes the best we have for 351 (better than Hill, Mason or Leone), so sit back and enjoy

I'd avoid if possible, she doesn't seem very knowledgeable about the subject. Often she wouldn't control the discussions well and conversations would go too long. Overall CSD is a pretty useless class but easy.
She was so nice and I loved how helpful she was.

Very helpful teacher. As has been said, takes a humanistic approach to lecturing. If a student doesn't understand something will sit down with them until they understand. Can lose the class's attention when there are boisterous students. 3 hour lectures can be a pain but she makes up for it by buying pizza. Several small assignments and labs to do.

This professor takes a very "human" approach to technology. However, the CSD class is extremely drawn out and boring. I feel that she didn't manage class discussion well enough and we usually found ourselves completely off-topic after 30 minutes of listening to two people in the class debate among themselves. Grades fairly.

Very helpful teacher. She explains all the materials in depth. She make jokes and get the class involved with questions making sure everyone is paying attention. Very friendly and helpful outside of class. So far her quiz aren't that bad. Would recommend taking her class.

Class was kind of long but I think most 350/351 classes are of this format.  Overall the class was well structured and the lectures, though long, covered all of the expected info that was laid out in the syllabus.  Tina tries to make the content as fun as possible, and definitely tries to help all students do well.  Quizzes / Tests aren't easy.....
Tina is a decent lecturer. Her knowledge is kind of outdated and has an ill get back to you attitude. Other than that, she is the sweetest person and buys pizza for the class occasionally.

Incredibly nice lady. Distinctively "human" compared to other professors. However, tests/quizzes/labs are slightly hard graded. Easy 5 pts extra credit. Be prepared to do a mini presentation and term paper for networking!!!

This lady is living in the past.. She does not have a clue about anything she teaches. Often goes on side rants about how she worked for IBM. She does not do ANY grading, she relies on graders who do not know anything about the material, so you are incorrectly graded. She also takes forever to answer email. Avoid, and take classes with Hill.

Most of the time when she teaches, I feel that she does not really comprehend what she is talking about. She likes to ramble on, while the whole class is not listening. She is pretty much clueless during the labs. She also takes FOREVER to grade things, don't expect to even have a ballpark of your grade until the end of the quarter.

She doesn't really know the material that she tries to teach. We had an awkward situation where we had the lab before the lecture, so we'd learn about the lab after we had already done it. She also posts Breeze presentations that she expects you to watch. Lab hardware sucks, so pick a good bench for the midterm and final practicals.

My favorite professor of all time. He is not a hand holder, you have to attend class, lecture slides are not provided. He knows his stuff top to bottom. You will learn so much if you aren't incompetent. I only wish I could take sys3 with him before I leave.

One of the best professors in the NSSA department. He's not a hand-holder, so don't expect to get coddled. Doesn't post slides, so attend lectures. You WILL learn when you take a course with Barido, and you WILL learn the material well. People will often say that they learned a lot with barido as a teacher. What they fail to mention is that Barido does not in fact teach you anything. Avoid this guy and this class

Had Professor Barido for Comp System Fundamentals an Sys Admin I. I thought he was fair in CSF but he ruined my life in Sys Admin 1. Take only if you feel like dealing with an old grouch.

Very good professor, and very knowledgeable about his subject. Learned a lot about UNIX and lectures were interesting. Already knew Windows stuff because I am a Windows Admin for a fortune 500 company. Take him, he can be a bit hard but you will walk away with a wealth of information

Omnipotent.  Extremely knowledgeable about subject.  He assigns a buttload of work and doesn't announce important dates.  Lectures result in boredom and slides are not posted.  Puts students on blast if they're sleeping or talking.

He is one of the worst professor I've ever had. Very boring, lecture with slides but don't provide them for students. Extremely unhelpful, such as answering your questions with his own questions. Seem to have an ego problem.

75% of the class is online exams, the remaining 25% is attendance. Easy class, professor has good stories about his job as a cop. W

A great funny man, my favorite proffessor!

Great professor

Professor Rosenbeck was a great guy with a real world experience that he really passes on to his students. He enjoys class participation and loves to talk about his material. Nice

Dr. T is a blessing to the chemistry department. He will do whatever he can to help you succeed

Always ready to help students, lectures were pretty engaging. Despite the difficulty of the material, he taught it intuitvely and the tests are very forgiving with tons of extra credit opportunities. Final was not stressful at all thanks to him adding an entire bonus test to the grade.

SUCH an amazing teacher! You can tell he loves his job and chemistry. Super helpful if you have a question about the content and really down to earth. Definitely sets you up for success in the long run.

Easy class, not too much pressure.  Pay attention and do the work and you'll get a good grade.  A little too easy, and according to my internet marketing teacher she didn't cover everything he thought was important.

She is really nice and helpful. She also is really understanding. So long as you put a little bit of work into the class then it is an easy A. Quizzes are online, and for everything she gives great guidance.
She knows her stuff. Her class may require some of your time, but you actually learn so many things about Marketing. Very helpful outside classes. She's also VERY nice. Would recommend her!

This professor is one of the BEST I have ever had!! She is really laid back and is just SUCH a wealth of knowledge about everything, electronics in particular. She puts up power points but just for referance. She is just AWESOME!!quizzes are hard, and you cant **** with her, she knows her****.

Professor Khorram has difficult exams but gives tons of practice problems to prepare. He also gives practice problems in class but exams tend to be much more difficult than anything given in class. He was an awesome Philosophy teacher who really knows the subject. For an intro class, he doesn't go too in depth, making it very manageable even if you dislike Philosophy. comment: Entire grade is based on 4 quizzes, made philosophy very interesting and he's funny and upbeat. Although he would post the slides like 2 days before the quizzes but that's because he wants people to go to class. I would recommend him highly because of how chill he is.

A wonderful professor that cares about the subject he's teaching and his students. Tries his best to make the lectures engaging and does a great job. Very understanding and kind. No final, 5 exams over the semester each worth 20%. Prof was very passionate and helped make the subject a little bit more interesting. comment: Solid Professor. As long as you have a brain that thinks, then you'll be just fine.

PHIL 101 is an easy course (just 5 quizzes), but regardless, the actual content of the lectures and readings are excellent. Prof. Aguilar is very passionate about the field of philosophy, and his coverage of the material during class is well-paced and engaging. His personality and enthusiasm make him one of the best lecturers I've had so far here.

You can tell he really enjoys teaching about the philosophers he's talking about in class. He genuinely likes debating with students about their opinions on the ideas presented. The topics are a bit abstract but really interesting and seemingly a good intro to the field. The whole grade is 5 noncumulative tests that are very simple.

To be honest, I did not find him too easy, but he is a pretty forgiving grader and he was very willing to give exceptions for deadlines and such. Most of the difficulty comes from the pretty long and in-depth readings we were given. His lectures are a bit hard to follow, but he is definitely passionate about what he teaches.

Prof Aguilar is fairly easy going when it comes to his class, even more so the bigger it is. My class less than half the people showed up on a regular basis. His lectures are pretty boring only because of the subject material, he personally has great energy. Also go to the last class of the semester, it is one of the most important.
Really liked him. Easy A.

Good professor if you need to fill an ethical perspective. Lectures got a bit long and boring sometimes, but he tries to make them an interesting introduction to philosophy. If you come to class and pay attention the exams are an easy A. Attendance isn't mandatory, but if you aren't there you will struggle on the exams. Overall a good professor.

Good professor. Enjoyable lecturer. Took philosophy 101 with him, and if you paid attention in class and took notes, the 5 tests your grade is based on are easy. He has non-mandatory attendance- don't be fooled. All the important info is ONLY in lecture. no notes on mycourses, nothing. Go to class and you don't even really need to do the reading.
tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'GRADED BY FEW THINGS']

comment: Lectures can be pretty interesting and are usually discussion heavy. The grading consisted of participation, 3 exams (essay questions) and a final paper. He's really passionate about this subject and is clear in how he presents information, but he can sometimes get carried away in over-explaining simple concepts.
tags: ['Get ready to read', 'GRADED BY FEW THINGS', 'LECTURE HEAVY']

comment: Professor Aguilar is an amazing professor. He gives good lectures and the class is very straightforward. You only get 5 exams, worth 20 points each.
Good teacher, and his tests weren't that difficult although his lectures were pretty boring. The tests had all multiple choices along with bonuses. You will do fine if you study.
Had class discussions on topics that would sometime throw our schedule off a little but we covered all of the topics. There were 3 essays and 1 final paper of 7 - 10 pages. No other homework.

The class is easy, but this man's lectures are soooo boring; he repeats himself a lot and over explains very simple concepts. It's a good class to take if you want an easy A, but just make sure you bring something to entertain yourself with if you decide to actually show up.

Very kind and approachable, very passionate and a clear grader, free bonus points included on everything, but honestly if you pay attention, it's very hard not to get 100 on everything, even if yyou don't read a single reading assigned, would definitely recommend

Prof Aguilar is an amazing professor. Take him for whatever course you can. He is so passionate about his field and always finds a way to make the lectures interesting. The tests are a bit challenging though but he really gets you thinking. Plus.. he's also really nice and you'll enjoy him! :)

He is a great professor. I had no interest in philosophy and he makes it as interesting as possible. I never did the readings, just take notes and study his hand outs. There are 5 tests, each out of 20 points and whatever your 5 tests add up to is your grade. There are 5 bonus points built into each test.

Jesus is a great teacher who is enthusiastic about the subject he teaches.  He portrays the topics well and makes you think about the moral issues introduced.  He will ask you to buy some books for class but you really don't need to.  He posts many of the readings online and many of the books can be found via google.  I would highly recommend him.
Easy tests, boring lectures. No real need to show up to class - just use SparkNotes and listen to him answering questions before the test.

Ignore the idiots that rated this guy a 1. This is one of the best teachers I've ever had. Crystal clear, easy grader, passionate (and extremely knowledgeable) about his field. I wholeheartedly recommend his class if you care at all about philosophy. Easy A if you pay attention and learn.

Amazing class. Extremely interesting, really gets you involved in thinking about the material. All you have to do is read, show up and take decent notes, and you'll do great. Four in-class tests count for 100% of grade. Tests are 2 essays. I wrote 1-1.5 pages each essay. Reviews material directly before test.  Easy A for me. Had an average above 98

I didn't like the how he teaches his classes. I respect that. I always fall asleep when I come to his classes. If you want to actually learn, then go ahead take his class. As for me, I was just looking for a LA class to fill up. Big mistake.
I'm not much of a philosophy person but he made it very easy to understand.
Very interesting class. He's a really good teacher. Not tested on text, tested on lecture, but he refers to quotes. 4 exams no final. No papers. No projects. Take notes, study notes you'll do great.
Very easy professor. Lectures are thought-provoking, and he tries to make the material clearer by using real world examples. He does tend to repeat himself quite a bit though. Highly recommended.
Great lecturer. Just show up, listen about 50% time, easy. no final, 4 exams total. very fair questions on exams. draws funny little doodles to help visualize scenarios. highly recommend.

He is a fantastic teacher, great at explaining things and making you understand them.  He quotes the book often so it's good to at least skim through it.  His lectures are the whole tests, but they are very easy anyway.  He also has a review for the test right before you take it.  Overall, take him if you have the chance!
great professor! very nice and keeps the class interesting... can tell he is interested in what he is teaching. fair grader.
Good teacher, although he had to try and handle a large class of about 70 students which sometimes proved to be cumbersome for him.  He is a good teacher and fair grader.
This guy is the man. I highly recommend this class, it's an easy grade. He fully describes all topics and there are four tests for the quarter, all in essay form. Very fair grader.
Only thing that held him back was stupid questions from students.
All readings are printed out for you, very clearly covers topics.  Tests are all essay.  Fair grader.  I would recommend for anyone.

Easy to approach and grading is fair. Made long, late classes enjoyable. Had him for 2d animation and grades were based on whether our animations were believable or not, so you don't have to be an artist to do well in his animation class. Gave constructive feedback on how to improve

Fun teacher to have. Easy to approach and grading is fair. Made long, late classes enjoyable. Had him for 2d animation and grades were based on whether our animations were believable or not, so you don't have to be an artist to do well in his animation class. Gave constructive feedback on how to improve our projects.
She always tries to help as much as possible. Easy going teacher.

GDD2 with Cody was the chill class I needed to survive the hellish junior year. He's ridiculously chill and gives you the respect you deserve as a third year student, while also making sure that everyone is on track to get their work done. 10/10 would take again.

Cody is one of the best professors I've ever had and one of the best in IGM. He is really nice and funny and just all-around great guy. He's really understanding of situations and cares about his students. He's responsive in emails asking for help, and he will sit with you in his office and work with you until your code works. Definitely take him!

Super great. I learned an incredible amount in all of Cody's classes. He really cares about students doing well, is very helpful, gives good feedback, and has great lectures that are easy to follow along with. Besides that he's a real cool dude, very funny and friendly. Take him if you can. I really loved and valued all his classes :)

Good professor, good projects, good class content. Entertaining to listen to as well. Class was pretty quiet in my section but I would suggest taking classes with him. So far one of the most valuable courses I have taken at RIT, much better than the prerequisite web dev course. Gives good options for both New Media and GDD students
approachable and fun , take him

One of the most approachable and fun professors I have had.  He's very helpful, extremely fair at grading, and is an all-around funny guy.  Homework is graded promptly and project outlines are clear.  Lectures can get a little boring if you're familiar with the subject.

Cody is the best teacher in IGM since Joe P left. His classes are interesting and taught well, he's very committed to students. He's an easy grader, it's more about putting in the effort and showing interest than checking the boxes. His sense of humor copy pasted from reddit but he doesn't overuse stale memes  too much.
Really easy class. I enjoyed it. Lots of projects but if you do your work its smooth sailing.

Took him for 110, taking him for 220 next semester, and whenever else I can. Literally the greatest teacher I've ever had probably. Love him to pieces, good professor and will make you feel like you're good friends, too.

Take his class if you can! He knows his stuff and gives a lot of practice exercises in class, and you code along with his class examples. Tries to make lectures fun and keep students alive in class. Exam questions are from a practice review packet he gives, so you know what to expect. Very helpful if you have trouble with the projects.

Cody was one of the greatest professors I have ever had. He knows his stuff and is very good at explaining and making sure you understand the topic. He is easily approachable and is very willing to help you if you need it. He made the class extremely fun, and made boring stuff enjoyable. Definitely take his class.

Take him if you can! He's an awesome guy and is always willing to help you. He makes lectures that SHOULD be boring actually quite interesting. He was my favorite professor for this semester. Some might complain about the workload, but it's really not bad if you manage your time well. It's hard to do bad in his class unless you don't do the work.

Lectures are often boring as he rambles on.  When you get a question wrong on exams, quizzes, or homework no reason as to given why.  Miss two classes he drops your grade by a whole letter grade (A to B, B to C, etc). Oh ya and his grading on true false questions.  Right +3, Wrong -2, Blank +1.  Don't actually answer them and take the free point.
